description: The Passalong accounts signed in on this machine, which one this session is using, and whether it still has to be chosen. With two or more and nothing chosen, every other call is refused until `use` says which: ask the PERSON, in plain words, and pass their answer. It lasts until this session ends and never moves the machine's default.

use.description: an account name from the list, as the person said it

name: accounts
title: Accounts on this machine
